message: The other night, I was in the kitchen whipping up dinner when I suddenly remembered I hadn’t checked the smoke alarm in a while. I grabbed my phone to look up how to test it, but of course, my battery was on its last leg. As I fumbled for the charger, I realized how essential it is to know these things without tech—like having a solid escape plan in mind. Technology can fail us at the worst times, can’t it? What’s a simple home safety tip you swear by?
